# Func Platform - LLM Developer Guide (llms.txt)
> Func (https://func.vn) is an Omnichannel Social CRM & Automation Backend for Zalo (User & Official Account), Facebook (Page & User Profile), and WhatsApp.

## 1. Quick Integration Summary
Developers or AI coding agents can integrate with Func via three primary mechanisms:
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Connect your AI Agent directly to `https://api.func.vn/mcp/sse?token=<API_TOKEN>`.
- **Public API (Machine-to-Machine RPC):** Send actions to `POST https://api.func.vn/public/functions/api`.
- **Client API (Multi-Tenant CRM):** Authenticate with JWT and call REST endpoints `/accounts/:account_pid/...`.

---

## 2. Authentication

### Method A: Account API Token (For Public API & Headless CRM)
- **Scope:** Binds to a single communication channel (Zalo/FB/WhatsApp account).
- **Header:** `Authorization: Bearer <FUNC_ACCOUNT_API_TOKEN>`
- **Use case:** Background workers, backend integrations, n8n, automated bots.

### Method B: User JWT Access Token (For Full CRM UI)
- **Scope:** Binds to the user's organization; can manage all connected accounts.
- **Login Endpoint:**
  ```http
  POST https://api.func.vn/auth/signin
  Authorization: Basic <base64(email:password)>
  ```
- **Header for subsequent calls:** `Authorization: Bearer <USER_JWT_TOKEN>`

---

## 3. Public API RPC Dispatcher
All programmatic actions are dispatched via a single endpoint:
- **URL:** `POST https://api.func.vn/public/functions/api`
- **Headers:**
  - `Authorization: Bearer <ACCOUNT_API_TOKEN>`
  - `Content-Type: application/json`
- **Payload Format:**
  ```json
  {
    "action": "ACTION_NAME",
    "data": { ...parameters }
  }
  ```

### Platform-Native Recipient Identifiers (CRITICAL FOR AI AGENTS):
- When calling Public RPC actions for specific social networks, use platform-native IDs (**DO NOT USE `contact_pid`**):
  - **ZALO_USER:** `user_id` (Zalo origin ID) OR `phone_number` (e.g. `"0912345678"`).
  - **ZALO_OA:** `user_id` (OA follower user ID).
  - **FACEBOOK_PAGE:** `recipient: { id: "psid" }`.
  - **WHATSAPP_USER:** `chat_id` (e.g. `"84912345678@s.whatsapp.net"`).
- `contact_pid` (e.g. `"zuser_123456"`) is ONLY used at the `FUNC` aggregation level (`FUNC_RUN_FLOW`, `FUNC_GET_MESSAGES`) or Client REST API (`/accounts/:account_pid/messages`).

### Most Common Actions:
- `USER_SEND_MESSAGE` (Zalo User): `{ user_id?: string, phone_number?: string, message: string, styles?: Array<{ start: number, len: number, st: "b"|"i"|"u"|"s" }> }`
- `SEND_MESSAGE` (Facebook Page): `{ recipient: { id: string }, message: { text: string } }`
- `SEND_MESSAGE` (WhatsApp User): `{ chat_id: string, message: string }`
- `SEND_MESSAGE` (Zalo OA): `{ user_id: string, message_data: { text: string } }`
- `ZNS_SEND_TEMPLATE` (Zalo OA): `{ phone_number: string, template_id: string, tracking_id: string, template_data: Record<string, any> }`
- `GROUP_SEND_MESSAGE` (Zalo Group): `{ group_id: string, message: string, styles?: Array<{ start: number, len: number, st: string }> }`
- `FIND_USER` (Zalo User): `{ phone_number: string }`
- `FUNC_RUN_FLOW` (Automation): `{ contact_pid: string, input?: Record<string, any> }`
- `FUNC_CREATE_CONTACT` (CRM): `{ origin_id: string, name?: string, phone?: string }`
- `FUNC_GET_MESSAGES` (CRM): `{ contact_pid: string, limit?: number }`

---

## 4. Subscription Plans & Permissions (Basic, Standard, Advanced, Advanced +)
Func categorizes permissions across 4 tiers: **Basic**, **Standard**, **Advanced**, and **Advanced +**.
- **Public API (Machine-to-Machine RPC):**
  - Most Public API actions (messaging, friends, contact upsert) only require the **Basic** plan.
  - **Exception:** Automation Flow action (`FUNC_RUN_FLOW`) strictly requires the **Standard plan or higher**.
- **Client REST API:**
  - Read & management endpoints (`GET /accounts`, `GET /contacts`, `GET /messages`) only require user login (any plan).
  - Outbound messaging from Client CRM (`POST /accounts/:account_pid/messages`) strictly requires the **Standard plan or higher**.

---

## 5. Zalo Text Formatting & UTF-16 Offset Rules
- In `USER_SEND_MESSAGE` and `GROUP_SEND_MESSAGE`, `styles` defines formatting:
  - `st`: `"b"` (bold), `"i"` (italic), `"u"` (underline), `"s"` (strikethrough), `"c_<color>"` (color).
  - `start` & `len` MUST be calculated using **UTF-16 code units** (standard JavaScript string indexing).
  - Emoji characters (e.g. 😊, 🚀, 🔥) count as **2 code units**. Add +2 to `start` for any emoji preceding formatted text.

---

## 6. Client REST API Endpoints
When building a custom web or mobile CRM interface:
- `GET /accounts`: List all connected social channels for the authenticated user.
- `GET /accounts/:account_pid/contacts?filter=<base64_json>`: List contacts with filters (search, tags, pagination).
- `POST /accounts/:account_pid/contacts`: Create a new contact.
- `PUT /accounts/:account_pid/contacts/:contact_pid`: Update contact tags, notes, attributes.
- `GET /accounts/:account_pid/contacts/:contact_pid/messages?limit=30`: Retrieve conversation messages.
- `POST /accounts/:account_pid/messages`: Send an outbound message (`{ contact_pid: string, message: string }`, requires Standard plan or higher).

---

## 7. Realtime Events & Webhooks
Func pushes events to your server when new messages arrive.
- **Webhook Payload Sample:**
  ```json
  {
    "event": "message.created",
    "account_pid": "acc_12345",
    "contact": {
      "pid": "zuser_98765",
      "name": "Nguyen Van A",
      "phone": "+84912345678"
    },
    "message": {
      "id": "msg_001",
      "text": "Hello, I need pricing info",
      "sent_at": 1740000000000
    }
  }
  ```
- **Socket.IO:** Connect to `wss://api.func.vn` with `{ auth: { token: "<USER_JWT>" } }` for live push.

---

## 8. Remote MCP Server Endpoint
AI Agents (Cursor, Windsurf, Claude Code, Cline) can connect to:
- **SSE Stream:** `https://api.func.vn/mcp/sse?token=<API_TOKEN>`
- **Direct POST:** `https://api.func.vn/mcp`
Available tools: `func_docs`, `func_list_actions`, `func_get_action_schema`, `func_get_action_guide`, `func_get_client_api_guide`, `func_get_webhook_guide`, `func_generate_typescript_sdk`.

---

For extended reference, full schemas, and TypeScript examples, see: `https://api.func.vn/llms-full.txt`.
